description: This file contains the prototype declarations for exported functions related to the CCSP CWMP Processor object in a network protocol implementation. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing processor objects, as well as licensing and licensing-related comments.

methods.name: CcspCwmpCreateProcessor
methods.description: Creates a new CCSP CWMP processor object given container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: CcspCwmppoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the CCSP CWMP processor.

methods.name: CcspCwmppoRemove
methods.description: Removes the CCSP CWMP processor instance.

methods.name: CcspCwmppoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects for the CCSP CWMP processor.
